meta.hierarchy: Custom editorial thematic hierarchy; not an official IAB hierarchy.
meta.code_policy: Every category has a unique lowercase r0_code. Scalar taxonomy fields hold primary codes. All original codes are retained exactly once in sources; explicitly merged aliases may have multiple source entries from one dictionary.
meta.merge_policy: Reviewed equivalent categories merged; original source records retained. Same-dictionary aliases may coexist in sources while scalar fields retain one primary code.
meta.name_policy: Custom section labels for roots; source name for other categories. All original names are retained in sources.
meta.placement_policy: 32 curated themes with explicit product/topic overrides; original finer parent relationships reused within the same theme. Primary source order: iab.content.3.1, iab.ad-product.2.0, iab.content.1.0.
meta.limitations: Matching names across dictionaries is an editorial correspondence, not an official assertion that content and advertised products are interchangeable. Scope remains limited to source categories; no unsupported AI Chat or other invented code.

hierarchy_adjustments.reason: Pornography is a narrower category of Adult & Explicit Sexual Content.
